clue.text: One whose survey extends from China to Ceylon?

definitions.text: One whose survey extends from China to Ceylon?

blocks.clueFragment: One whose survey extends from China to Ceylon?
blocks.note: surface reading: a traveller or mapmaker covering Asia from China down to Sri Lanka
setter's reading: China and Ceylon are kinds of the drink, so the survey is of brews, done by mouth

explanation.surface: An explorer surveys the whole of Asia from China south to Ceylon.
explanation.walkthrough: China and Ceylon are both names of teas, so the 'survey' is a professional tasting of them. Ceylon is the old name of Sri Lanka.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea-taster samples and grades blends professionally, so their range of judgement runs across varieties named after those producing countries.

clue.text: Signaller, of course, gives so called instant food to crew

explanation.definitionFit: A tic-tac man is a bookmakers' assistant who relays changing odds across a racecourse using a code of hand signals.

clue.text: In America, bear wanted, say, for him?
